name: Aetheen of the Gales
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face.

The one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on Zephras Isle, and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Aetheen of the Gales in Thendal Grove.
narrative.offerRewardText: Rorian has told me much of you. I am likely unknown to you, but I am a member of the Council of Elders here on Zephras Isle. I've come to read the flow of the winds here in Thendal Grove. I'm also here to assess young shen'dorei such as yourself that are coming of age.So tell me, are you ready to take your next step? Are you ready to serve Zephras Isle?
